mapper.sql: SELECT c.COURSE_ID, c.COURSE_NAME, c.DESCRIPTION, c.INSTRUCTOR_ID, u.USER_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME, c.MAJOR, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.CAPACITY, c.ENROLLED_CNT, c.STATUS_CD, s.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME FROM TB_COURSE c JOIN TB_USER u ON u.USER_ID = c.INSTRUCTOR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE s ON s.GROUP_CD = 'COURSE_STATUS' AND s.CODE = c.STATUS_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COURSE (COURSE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, INSTRUCTOR_ID, MAJOR, START_DATE, END_DATE, CAPACITY, STATUS_CD) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{description}, #{instructorId}, #{major}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{capacity}, #{statusCd})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COURSE SET COURSE_NAME = #{courseName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, MAJOR = #{major}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, CAPACITY = #{capacity}, STATUS_CD = #{statusCd} WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
